known_differences.description: CASP portfolio uses Hager-Higham 1-norm rcond estimator and falls back from LU to QR/SVD on high backward error.

threats.description: Ill-conditioned or pivot-growth dense systems (e.g., Wilkinson or Hilbert matrices) defeat LU backward error.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/lib.rs:2806 (solve_tikhonov_regularized): computes Oettli-Prager backward error for CASP portfolio fallback and applies SVD Tikhonov regularization in Hardened mode under RecoveryPolicy::Regularize.
threats.strict_mode_response: Evaluate CASP portfolio and fallback on backward-error failure while emitting SolveCertificate.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject ConditionTooHigh by default or apply SVD Tikhonov regularization under RecoveryPolicy::Regularize, recording BoundedRecovery in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Singular matrices, non-square matrices, non-finite entries, or mismatched RHS lengths passed to dense linear solvers.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/lib.rs:4207 (solve_with_audit): validates square matrix dimensions, RHS compatibility, and non-singularity, or projects non-finite entries to 0.0 under Hardened + RecoveryPolicy::Project.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(LinalgError::SingularMatrix) or Err(LinalgError::ShapeMismatch) matching SciPy LinAlgError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject fail-closed by default or project non-finite entries under RecoveryPolicy::Project with AuditAction::BoundedRecovery in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Non-SPD matrices passed to Cholesky factorization or oversized dense dimensions in Hardened mode.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/complex.rs:1027 (cholesky): detects non-positive pivots immediately and aborts factorization with NonPositiveDefinite error.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(LinalgError::NonPositiveDefinite) at first non-positive pivot.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce HARDENED_MAX_DIM bound and reject non-SPD or non-finite inputs fail-closed.

threats.description: Bunch-Kaufman LDLT pivot selection on indefinite symmetric matrices drifting from LAPACK dsytrf.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/bunch_kaufman.rs:116 (solve): implements exact 1x1 and 2x2 Bunch-Kaufman pivoting matching LAPACK.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match LAPACK dsytrf pivot sequence and singularity signaling.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate input finiteness and symmetry assumptions before factorization.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Always reject non-finite entries and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
Return LinalgError::ShapeMismatch and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return LinalgError::SingularMatrix when all portfolio actions fail.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return LinalgError::SingularMatrix and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Allow arbitrary dimensions within host memory.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject inputs with n > HARDENED_MAX_DIM (10,000) fail-closed.
